title: senecio johnstonii var. friesiorum
intro: Senecio johnstonii var. friesiorum, commonly known as the Johnston's ragwort, is a plant species within the dandelion family (Asteraceae) characterized by its distinctive leaves and flowers. The plant is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to alleviate pain, reduce stress, and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Johnston's ragwort include its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit antimicrobial activity, and act as a mild sedative. The plant's bioactive constituents include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties.
